scope: one fixed-seed, two-position explicit series versus active one-of-two parallel RBD pair

direct_parent.behavior_scope: two position-identified critical modes, direct half-hour CM and three scheduled missions

accepted_instructional_prerequisite.behavior_scope: explicit nested installed item failure, physical replacement and repair

source.interpretation: An explicit mission operational mode maps the system to a root RBD. Each leaf position also needs a matching MaterielOperationalModes row with no child RBID, as shown on physical manual page 770 and required by native converter error #464 in the excluded v1.0.0 diagnostic. A series block requires both position blocks; an active parallel block with NBREQ=1 and NBOP=2 remains functional while at least one position functions. ONLM=N excludes online maintenance. Both positions are direct components of the accepted parent system.

source_delta: Both arms change only Control.RELOP to RBD and ProblemDescription, then add OperationalModes, MissionOperationalModes, MaterielOperationalModes, and either RBDSeries/RBDSeriesStructure or RBDParallel/RBDParallelStructure. Each block uses POS-A and POS-B once with G04-OPS child mode, and each leaf has a matching MaterielOperationalModes row with empty RBID. The parallel arm has NBREQ=1, NBOP=2, TSWOV=0, ONLM=N. Existing modes, stocks, CM rows, three missions, one replication, seed 1 and 36-hour horizon remain unchanged.
predeclared_native_acceptance: For each arm, guarded session-0 SSH import, export, calculation, JSON report and source roundtrip complete at zero exit codes with GUI PID 13340 preserved; conversion errors are zero and warning #108 alone is acceptable. The 23 row-containing authored tables must roundtrip exactly; valid event log and 72 aligned half-hour System and Stock bins must be present.

Each arm must show position-identified failures and the associated individual mission/CM events. Reconcile SystemResults failure, repair, mission-success and readiness intervals, plus StockTotalResults zero-demand/zero-backorder ledgers and terminal state.

The fixed seed should expose an isolated first POS-B branch failure during the first 8-10h mission, as in the accepted G02 parent. In the explicit series arm, one failed block makes the mission/system fail. In active parallel, if POS-A remains functional, the first POS-B failure must leave the mission operational through its planned end. Direct event and report evidence must establish the block-state contrast; source configuration or a summary alone is insufficient.

If the random event sequence differs from the parent or the contrast is not observed, retain the runs as diagnostic and revise the contract/new run with fresh IDs before accepting a narrower statement. No fixed event time is assumed as an assertion.
Seal raw artifacts and source hashes; obtain a separate read-only reviewer replay of both native arms without importing author validation code.
limits: This is one seed, two direct position blocks and one mission mode; population reliability and all RBD Boolean structures are unverified.
Passive backup, switchover, online maintenance, QTYPB>1, nested series/parallel, bridge/tree, alternate mission modes, GUI RBD view and cross-engine parity remain separate scopes.
